programme.desc: Benny es deportado de Estados Unidos a un México desgarrado por la guerra entre cárteles del narcotráfico. Se involucra en el negocio narco y asciende rápidamente, rodeado de dinero, mujeres, violencia y excesos.

programme.title: Una mujer sin filtro
programme.desc: Paz, una amable mujer, permitió que todos alrededor de ella la trataran como si no fuera nada, manteniendo el silencio para no herir ningún sentimiento. Hasta que un día, un fenómeno fuerza su cabeza a expresar lo que siente.

programme.title: Casese Quien Pueda
programme.desc: The best-laid love plans go hilariously awry in this romantic-comedy hit about two sisters (Martha and Miriam Higareda) who find themselves in uncharted romantic territory.

programme.title: Cantinflas - [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: Cantinflas es la historia jamás contada de la mayor y más adorada estrella mexicana de la comedia de todos los tiempos.

programme.title: La virgen de agosto (LAS)
programme.desc: Eva decide quedarse durante agosto en Madrid, todo un acto de fe, para poder ver y sentir las cosas de otra manera y encontrar nuevas oportunidades.

programme.title: Diamantes negros
programme.desc: Amadou y Moussa son descubiertos en Malí por un ojeador de fútbol, separados de sus familias para convertirse en estrellas del balompié. Emprenden un viaje que les mostrará el mundo de sombras que se esconde tras el deporte rey.

programme.title: Compadres
programme.desc: Un policía mexicano y un joven americano hacker de computadores, unen fuerzas para entregar un criminal a la justicia en esta comedia de acción llena de altas emociones y risas escandalosas.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Sky is forced to make a life-altering decision. Puma's celebration turns ugly when Alexis confronts Donna about her past. When O'Sh*t blows off a client, Ceaser reaches his breaking point. Rah Ali shows up to Black Ink.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew heads north for some snow-tubing fun. O'Sh*t gets a grim warning from his doctor. Donna must make a decision about Max. Ceaser celebrates the new shop and O'Sh*t makes a decision that will change Black Ink forever.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser ushers in a new era of Black Ink at his new shop on 125th Street while Teddy takes the reins of 113th as the new executive manager. Donna finds out that her husband Max is still involved with his ex.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: O'Sh*t returns to Harlem with a new name and a new flame. Ted transforms Ceaser's old office into a Boom Boom Room and hires a new tattoo artist with a questionable past. Ceaser's brand ambassador Kitty incites a brawl when she insults the 113th shop.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser is forced to confront his employees after learning that Kitty was jumped. A rumor sends Young Bae into attack mode while Nikki finally agrees to let Richard work at 113th. Sky concocts a crazy plan to get Donna back at the shop.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Dutchess takes over 113th and plans a 24-hour tattoo-a-thon to save the shop, but a fight between Sky and Tiffany threatens to ruin the entire event. An urgent call from Richard has Nikki racing to the Bronx courthouse.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Don brings his two baby mamas together in hopes of uniting his family. Ryan celebrates his 30th birthday with a Great Gatsby themed bash. And Danielle's boyfriend Terrence makes a fool of himself when his jealousy gets the best of him. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Don receives some life-shattering news. Charmaine auditions to be a radio DJ. Phor heads into the studio with one of hip hop's top rappers to record a song. Ryan is forced to make a tough decision about Cobra's future at 9 Mag. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Kat hosts her first art show, but Phor shows up with the woman he cheated on Kat with. Van confesses to his girl that he's not a one-woman kind of guy. Phor's girlfriend Nikki confronts Kat about her attitude —and things get physical. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: The 9 Mag crew heads to the Dominican Republic for Don's wedding. Kat confronts Phor about cheating on her. Van's threesome goes wrong when his girlfriend brings a guest. Don gets too friendly with a stripper, jeopardizing his wedding. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Ashley enlists her brother to spy on Don's bachelor party. Terrence gives Danielle an ultimatum—him or 9 Mag. And Ashley threatens to call off the wedding when she sees scandalous photos of Don at his bachelor party. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Ryan battles his staff over their growing disrespect towards him. Don and Ashley's marital bliss is threatened. Kat leaves Chicago for LA. Van starts a brawl at the 9Mag anniversary party. Ashley starts trouble with Charmaine. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: The New Barack and Michelle Obama

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Sky ends up with stitches when Tiffany confronts her about her attitude. Melody wants to return to Black Ink. Sky shares a closely guarded secret with Ceaser. Richard and Nikki's wedding celebration turns ugly.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Walt tries to convince Richard to take care of his legal situation. Ceaser is shocked when Donna shows up at the shop wanting her job back. Dutchess comes home to NYC to celebrate her magazine cover.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser is shocked when Dutchess leaves him. Sky asks her female co-workers for a very personal favor. Walt and Sky introduce Young Bae to online dating. Sky fears for her safety when a man from her past shows up at the shop.
programme.sub-title: The Ring Didn't Mean A Thing

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew takes Ceaser to Miami for some sun, sand, and senoritas. Richard battles it out in court with Kathie over custody of their son. Dutchess receives a disturbing phone call that has her questioning her decision to leave NYC

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Mary's obsession includes hoarding cats, and her friends and family have no idea about the horror that awaits them when they walk through her door.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Lisa is an active chef, a member of various cooking groups, an expert on historical cooking gadgets -- and a compulsive food hoarder.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Find out what happened to five of our most memorable hoarders years after they faced a crisis due to their hoard!

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Merlene had it all--an international supermodel married to the son of the inventor of the Lear Jet. But her storybook life fell apart when she got divorced, and now her house is crammed to the ceiling.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Barbara trolls for stuff in alleyways and dumpsters, and her hoarded home sits in a million-dollar neighborhood where the neighbors look on in disgust.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Anna tried to hide her hoarding from her family, but when her suspicious daughter snuck into the house to take pictures, Anna's secret was finally exposed.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: The small paths in Michelle's house are the only way she can get to her collection of more than 60 birds. Her husband of 30 years has been chased from the home by the animals and the hoarded piles that in some places reach five feet high.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: A Sophia Loren look-alike, Marie was born into an Italian mob family.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: A talkative, eccentric, antiques collector, Michael, 52, was a military brat who moved with his family all over Europe.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Rob was already a successful business owner when he inherited over a million dollars and several valuable properties from his father.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Now 53, Richard has kept a traumatic childhood event secret all his life.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: A talented cellist and an aspiring music producer, Shane's musical aspirations are now out of reach because he abuses prescription drugs and deals drugs out of his grandmother's house.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Friends and family gather to save two addicts--Rachel, once a beautiful child in an upper-middle class family who has turned to heroin and prostitution, and Tommy, who quit his executive job and sold his Lexus to sustain his cocaine habit.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Erin is a strong-willed Texan who relies on her good looks to get what she wants, which is meth.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Growing up in a South Boston neighborhood run by the Irish mob, Tom got caught up in the gangster lifestyle.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: We revisit with two of our subjects to see how they've been doing since we first profiled them.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Tiffany, 24, a former athlete and cheerleader who dreamed of a career in the medical field, has no intention of giving up her IV crystal meth addiction.

programme.title: La estafa maestra
programme.desc: Tras ser traicionados y abandonados a su suerte en Italia, Charlie Croker y su equipo planean un elaborado robo de oro contra su antiguo aliado.

programme.title: Terminator 2: juicio final
programme.desc: La máquina no humana que domina la élite del futuro devastado por la guerra despacha un cíborg asesino al pasado para matar a un jovencito porque pronto será el líder de la resistencia en contra de la máquina.

programme.title: La vigilante del futuro
programme.desc: Major (Scarlett Johansson) es la primera de su clase: Una mente humana dentro de un cuerpo artificial. Al descubrir que sus creadores mintieron sobre su pasado para controlarla, no se detendrá hasta revelar su verdadera identidad y vengarse.

programme.title: Colateral: Lugar y tiempo equivocado
programme.desc: Vincent es un asesino a sueldo tranquilo y calculador que está en su mejor momento. Max es un taxista con grandes sueños y sin resultados. Esta noche, Max llevará a Vincent a su próximo trabajo. Una noche, cinco paradas, cinco asesinatos y un escape.

programme.title: Bad Ass
programme.desc: A Vietnam veteran who becomes a local hero after saving a man from attackers on a city bus decides to take action when his best friend is murdered and the police show little interest in solving the crime.

programme.title: El yakuza americano
programme.desc: Viggo Mortensen (Green Book) interpreta a un agente del FBI encubierto que ha ascendido en las filas de la Yakuza y ahora se ve atrapado en una guerra entre la Yakuza, la mafia y el FBI.

programme.title: Un plan infalible
programme.desc: Un ingenioso trío de ladrones disfrazados debe luchar por sus vidas y el botín cuando un verdadero criminal maestro los chantajea para que planifiquen y ejecuten un atraco de $20 millones. Protagonizada por Ryan Reynolds.

programme.title: Proyecto Géminis
programme.desc: Will Smith protagoniza esta trepidante película de acción del director ganador de un Óscar Ang Lee. Un asesino a sueldo retirado (Smith) se ve obligado a huir y acaba siendo perseguido por su mayor adversario: un clon más joven de sí mismo.

programme.title: Hansel y Gretel: Cazadores de brujas

programme.title: Battlerstar Galactica

programme.title: Battlerstar Galactica

programme.desc: The aftermath of the Globelink Christmas party.

programme.desc: Gus and George interview replacements for Alex.

programme.desc: Mandy is deeply in debt, but has a new job and a rich boss; Martin is still obsessed with his ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The Bad Back
programme.desc: When Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Del(Eric Lutes) get carried away competing on the racquetball court, Caroline injures her back and ends up confined to bed.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The ATM
programme.desc: When Caroline gets stiffed at her ATM, she meets with bank personnel to retrieve her money. However, because the surveillance camera captured her in an awkward moment, she's too embarrassed to let the bank manager view the tape of her transaction.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The Convict
programme.desc: When Caroline and Del agree to go to dinner with Annie and Warren, her new boyfriend, they find that Annie left out one minor detail about his background --Warren's an ex-convict with a burglary record.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The Gift
programme.desc: When Caroline finds out the Christmas gift Del gave her might have been extremely expensive, she ponders the message he may be trying to send her about their relationship.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The Married Man
programme.desc: Richard sets Caroline up on a date with an art council member who happens to hold the key to Richard's future as a successful artist, but when he finds out the man is married Richard wrestles with protecting a friend or furthering his career.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The Watch
programme.desc: When Caroline and Richard bicker over their shared work space, Caroline finds the perfect solution when she purchases an antique partner's desk from the desk's original owners, writing and life partners Vic Stansky and Stella Dawson.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The Bad Date
programme.desc: Annie re-introduces Caroline to the wonderful world of dating, by taking her on a man-hunt, but when Caroline thinks she has met the perfect man, she later finds that he's no love connection.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The Proposal
programme.desc: When Del surprises Caroline (Lea Thompson) with a marriage proposal, Richard (Malcolm Gets) feels he no longer fits into Caroline's life and decides it's time to look for another job.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The Ex-Wife
programme.desc: When Del (Eric Lutes) takes Caroline (Lea Thompson) on a spontaneous weekend trip, they unexpectedly run into Del’s bitter ex-wife Jill (guest star Joely Fisher) and her boyfriend Blair (guest star Kenny Johnson).

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The Movie
programme.desc: When Caroline and Annie discover that a John Landis movie is shooting in their neighborhood, they jump at the chance to become extras, but Annie’s excitement turns to sheer bliss when she learns that her dream man is starring in the film.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And Richard's Mom
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) helps Richard (Malcolm Gets) confront unresolved issues with his jet-setting mother, Natalie (Elizabeth Ashley, “Evening Shade”), when she makes a surprise visit to New York.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Wedding Deception
programme.desc: When Oscar and Felix attend the wedding of an old college friend, Oscar aims to reconnect with an old flame while Felix is determined to show his ex-wife (guest star Christine Woods) that he's a changed man.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Heal Thyself
programme.desc: Felix's hypochondria kicks into overdrive when Oscar starts dating the most important person in Felix's life - his doctor. Erinn Hayes guest stars as Sharon.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Secret Agent Man
programme.desc: Felix convinces Oscar to appear on a sports television show against Teddy's advice to stick with radio. NFL Network's Rich Eisen and 'Inside the NBA on TNT's' Kenny Smith guest star as themselves.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Unger Games
programme.desc: When Oscar feels threatened by Felix's surprising performance on the softball field and basketball court, they agree to a decathlon to determine which one of them is the better athlete. Geoff Stults guest stars.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Sleeping Dogs Lie
programme.desc: When Oscar and Felix make a trip to Ashley's (Christine Woods) to retrieve Felix's special pillow, a secret that he has kept from Oscar is revealed. Five-time NBA All-Star Chris Webber guest stars.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Enlightening Strikes
programme.desc: When Felix substitute teaches a yoga class, his teaching style rubs everyone, including Emily, the wrong way. Weird Al Yankovic and Regis Philbin guest star.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Jealous Island
programme.desc: Oscar becomes obsessed with living up to Murph's (Geoff Stults) standards when he finds out the girl he is seeing used to date the handsome ex-baseball player.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?: The 22 Episode
programme.desc: The family oversleeps on the day Lindsey is scheduled to sing the national anthem at a baseball game. Meanwhile, Kevin gets sick.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?: The Cooking Episode
programme.desc: Nick and Suzanne go head to head in the kitchen when Nick says cooking is \\"easy\\" and Suzanne challenges him to a family cooking competition.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?: The Regift Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne tries to return an unlikely gift from Marilyin with Nick not knowing.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?: The Suzanne Gets Arrested Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne gets arrested and decides to change her stubborn ways.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?: The Second Black President Episode
programme.desc: Kevin tries to run for seventh-grade class president, but he is torn about how to run his campaign.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?: The Green Episode
programme.desc: The family tries become environmental friendly with each other but chaos ensures

programme.title: Are We There Yet?: The Father's Day Episode
programme.desc: Frank is an uninvited guest on Nick's Father's Day trip, but the two bond during an elevator stoppage.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?: The My First Job Episode
programme.desc: Lindsey gets her first job at a fast food restaurant, but soon gets fired when she gives out free food.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?: The Tiger Dad Episode
programme.desc: Nick tries to become a more effective parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey to become better people.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?: The Expensive Purse Episode
programme.desc: Against Nick's wishes, Suzanne buys an expensive purse and Nick becomes suspicious about it, so he uses her guilt to his advantage.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Matt Baker turns his friends into a real-life mob after being inspired by Casino.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Fatal Encounters
programme.desc: Keith Douglas is met with a barrage of bullets as he opens his door. The police are looking to Dr. G for hard evidence to link certain suspects to the murder.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Poison Control
programme.desc: Chris Schaffer has not been seen or heard from in five days. Finally, his friends find him dead and decomposed in the driver’s seat of his van.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Deadly Holiday
programme.desc: While at dinner, Virginia Lowery chokes on a fishbone. Later that night, she suddenly can’t breathe and dies. Virginia’s family hopes that Dr. G can provide them with closure.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Ashes to Ashes
programme.desc: On a Texas highway, a fire is discovered having burnt three bodies beyond recognition. Dr. G finds bullets in the bodies and determines that they were all shot before being set on fire.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Twist of Fate
programme.desc: An elderly woman is driving when she’s overcome with shooting pains and crashes her car. She’s rushed to the hospital, but the doctors find nothing wrong. Can Dr. G find the cause of death?

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Emma Golightly – Lonely Hearts Con Woman
programme.desc: Golightly conned tens of thousands of dollars from men she found in lonely hearts columns and dating sites.
programme.sub-title: Emma Golightly – Lonely Hearts Con Woman

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Robert Hendy-Freegard – The Terrorist Trickster
programme.desc: Dubbed “The Most Evil Conman Ever” by the British press, Hendy-Freegard terrorized victims into believing they were terrorist targets.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Gene Morrison – Fraudulent Forensics Expert
programme.desc: He faked his own credentials and netted $400,000 of taxpayers money, giving bogus court testimony and investigative services.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Danger in the Woods
programme.desc: Three teenagers accompany a deliveryman to a densely wooded area for a drinking party that, before long, becomes a nightmare. Things take a terrifying turn when one of teens attacks the others.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Faith Healer
programme.desc: A trucker at a roadside rest station discovers the fully clothed body of a dead East Indian woman.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Loch Ness Monster
programme.desc: In 1998, in a normally peaceful suburb, a pervert on a bicycle appears, performing sexual acts on himself and then attacking teenage girls. For reasons apparent to the residents, they nickname him after the Scottish Loch Ness monster.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Game
programme.desc: 1995 - Houston, Texas. A lonely man calls a dating service and gets more than he bargained for when he is met at gunpoint and robbed by his “dates”. The women, dubbed “Thelma & Louise”, lure men with the promise of sex but then drug and rob them.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Cold Hit
programme.desc: In 1994, a troubled single mother is found raped and murdered in her apartment. Was it one of the volatile men in her life? All possible suspects are eliminated and the case goes cold for three years, until a nine-year old girl is brutally raped.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Ghost
programme.desc: A cunning arsonist stays one step ahead of the police and terrifies a small farming community until behavioural profiling help detectives zero in on a very unlikely suspect.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Nightmare
programme.desc: Every woman’s worst nightmare comes to life when a bearded sexual predator starts attacking women in the safety of their own apartments while they are sleeping.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Fat Bandit
programme.desc: A string of bank robberies in Winnipeg confound local police. Most bank-robbers are addicts, usually quite thin. This new man doesn't fit the profile: this bandit is fat.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Sweet Killer
programme.desc: An aging hippy is going through bad times. When he's found dead in his home with a gut of antifreeze, it's a closed case. Then a shocking confession reveals a maelstrom of lies and a story of cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Drost Notthoff Case
programme.desc: On September 11th 2011, in Èze, near Monaco, the owner of a luxury villa discovers the lifeless hanging body of his tenant, a rich German businessman.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Raphael Lomoro Case
programme.desc: On June 12th 2007, in Berhen-lès-Forbach, in Moselle, a young woman reports the disappearance of her brother Raphaël Lomoro, 46 years old vanilla producer living in Madagascar.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Hanging On Houseboat (Aubry case)
programme.desc: Dominique Aubry, a rich widow of 58, is found hanged on her barge in Neuilly. It appears that since the death of her husband on a trip to Mauritius, Dominique Aubry has been ailing.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair
programme.desc: On June 30, 2014, in Nancy, the police are called to the home of Julie Martin, a 34-year-old nurse.
programme.sub-title: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Jean-Jacques Le Page Case
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin.

programme.title: Gambit
programme.desc: A mild-mannered art curator (Colin Firth) plans to scam his abusive boss with the help of an expert forger (Tom Courtenay) and a rodeo queen (Cameron Diaz).

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: When their attempt to rob a gangster's (Robert De Niro) casino goes awry, a desperate man (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and his partner (Dave Bautista) hijack a city bus to escape from the police and a maniacal thug (Morris Chestnut).

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: An expert (Sylvester Stallone) in prison security joins forces with an inmate (Arnold Schwarzenegger) to break out of a top-secret, high-tech facility.

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: A reporter (Terrence Howard), his former colleague (Richard Gere) and a rookie (Jesse Eisenberg) search for Bosnia's most-wanted war criminal.

programme.title: The Family
programme.desc: After snitching on the mob, a Mafia boss (Robert De Niro) and his family enter the Witness Protection Program and relocate to a sleepy town in France, but their insistence on resorting to their old habits places them in danger from vengeful cronies.

programme.title: Dune
programme.desc: Paul Atreides (Kyle MacLachlan) leads the fight for vital spice on a desert planet in the year 10191.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: An alien soldier (James Caviezel) crashes on Earth during the time of the Vikings and blends his technology with theirs to hunt his enemy.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: Betrayed by his stepfather, the King, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love, Hercules must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: The Cimmerian warrior slashes his way across Hyboria on a mission that begins as a personal vendetta but turns into an epic battle against a supernatural evil.

programme.title: South Park: Cr***le Fight
programme.desc: Cr***le Fight: It's Timmy vs. Jimmy! But does Jimmy know this? The boys are joining the Scouts (troop 69) but their parents aren't so sure when they discover who the Scout Leader is. (S5, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Terrance and Phillip: Behind the Blow
programme.desc: Terrance and Phillip - Behind The Blow: The boys face death at the hands of some unhinged environmentalists unless they can re-unite Terrance and Phillip for a show at Earth Day Festival! (S5, E05)
programme.sub-title: Terrance and Phillip: Behind the Blow

programme.title: South Park: Cartmanland
programme.desc: Cartmanland: When Cartman inherits $1million and purchases his own theme park, Stan starts to question his faith in God. It's not long before things start to go out of control for Cartman. (S5, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter than Summer: Proper Condom Use
programme.desc: Proper Condom Use: After Cartman and Stan play "red rocket" with their dogs, their parents decide it's time for some school sex education. What the school provides creates worse problems! (S5, E07)
programme.sub-title: Hotter than Summer: Proper Condom Use

programme.title: South Park: Towelie
programme.desc: Towelie: Stan's mother buys the boys a console called The Okama Gamesphere but it is stolen whilst they are at school. To get it back they must help a talking towel take on the government! (S5, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants
programme.desc: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants: The boys send $1 to Afghan children and receive a goat back. When they try to return it an adventure ensues! First episode to air after 9/11. (S5, E09)
programme.sub-title: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants

programme.title: South Park: How To Eat With Your Butt
programme.desc: How To Eat With Your Butt: It's school photo time. Kenny decides to play a prank by wearing his parka upside down and revealing his buttocks. Cartman decides to take it a step further. (S5, E10)
programme.sub-title: How To Eat With Your Butt

programme.title: South Park: The Entity
programme.desc: The Entity: Kyle's annoying cousin arrives in town and it's not long before the boys are doing their best to get rid of him. Mr Garrison invents a slightly sexual new mode of transport. (S5, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Here Comes The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Here Comes The Neighbourhood: Token is picked on for being rich so decides to market the town as a millionaire's playground - cue Will Smith and Snoop Dogg moving in! Class war follows! (S5, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Kenny Dies
programme.desc: Kenny Dies: When Kenny is diagnosed with a terminal illness, Stan takes it especially hard. Will Cartman's truck load of foetuses help with a cure? Or does he have other plans for them... (S5, E13)

programme.desc: Pancho Villa envia un emisario al pueblo de paredones para conseguir apoyo de sus partidarios en el ataque que piensa realizar. Para ser reconocido por la persona a quien lo envia, el alcalde de paredones, le da su caballo "siete leguas" como regalo.

programme.title: El Enmascarado de Plata
programme.desc: El médico, un enmascarado cuyo fin es defender a los desprotegidos, se convierte en un hábil luchador capaz de hacer frente a los delincuentes más peligrosos, pues siguiendo los pasos de su padre, un verdadero hombre de ciencia.

programme.title: Santo Vs El Estrangulador
programme.desc: Cosas extrañas suceden en el teatro de una localidad donde se presentan diversas obras musicales, ya que alguien ha estado matando a varias bailarinas y actrices de dichas obras.

programme.title: El Último Round
programme.desc: Julio Torres, bailarín de un centro nocturno, llama la atención de un señor de negocios del boxeo, el sr. Suares, quien logra convencer a Julio para que deje de ser bailarín para que se dedique al boxeo. Pronto Julio se vuelve muy famoso.

programme.title: El Secreto De El Texano
programme.desc: Narran las aventuras de un justiciero apodado el texano quien es culpado de un asesinato que no cometió y en su huida, se topa con un pueblo en el que los únicos habitantes recogen oro del rio más cercano. Pero uno de estos pueblerinos.

programme.title: El Texano
programme.desc: Manuel Saldívar, conocido como el texano viaja a un pueblo minero para cobrar venganza por la muerte de su hermano juan Saldívar quien fue acusado injustamente de cobrar un poco de oro.

programme.title: Arriba Las Manos Texano
programme.desc: El texano, hijo de Manuel Saldivar, un asesino cruel y desalmado, emprende un viaje para llegar al rancho de Joe Pastrana. Al llegar se entera por su hija, que Joe a muerto victima de una balacera comandada por Jim, un cruel hombre.

programme.title: Un Hombre Peligroso
programme.desc: Tras cumplir seis años en prisión por un crimen que no había cometido, Shane Daniels es absuelto con una disculpa del Estado de Arizona. Shane debe luchar a su manera en un país corrupto y asegurarse de que la chica salga con vida.

programme.title: El Matador
programme.desc: Julian Noble conoce a Danny Wright en un bar de Ciudad de México. La inesperada conexión entre ambos conduce a una amistad llena de giros y sorpresas, que pone a prueba sus vidas y sus percepciones de la lealtad y la moralidad.

programme.title: CAOS
programme.desc: Dos policías, un novato (Phillipe) y un veterano (Statham) persiguen a un exitoso ladrón de bancos (Snipes)

programme.title: Rescate Sangriento
programme.desc: Un ganster ruso retirado, actualmente escritor de novelas, es tentado a volver a la vida criminal cuando descubre que su hija va a casarse con el hijo de su enemigo.

programme.title: El Vendedor Chino
programme.desc: Yan Jian, un joven ingeniero chino se ofrece para ir al norte de África y ayudar a la compañía para la que trabaja a ganar una competencia. El espía francés Michael también intenta ganarla para controlar los grandes recursos minerales de África.

programme.title: Armados y peligrosos
programme.desc: Dos criminales se meten en problemas con la patrulla fronteriza de los Estados Unidos, después de reunirse con un narcotraficante mexicano.

programme.title: Dragones Eternamente
programme.desc: Jackie es contratado para defender a una empresa acusada de contaminar las aguas de la ciudad. Para encontrar que producen las drogas, Jackie decide cambiar de bando.

programme.title: CAOS
programme.desc: Dos policías, un novato (Phillipe) y un veterano (Statham) persiguen a un exitoso ladrón de bancos (Snipes)

programme.title: Historia policiaca parte II
programme.desc: Los métodos inusuales de un oficial de policía de Hong Kong lo llevan a ser degradado a tráfico a pesar de su éxito. Mientras tanto, un viejo enemigo sale de prisión en busca de venganza.

programme.title: Oceans Rising
programme.desc: Un científico construye un arca enorme después de que se ignoran sus advertencias de una inundación que destruirá la Tierra. El desastre es inevitable, y los que difamaron al científico suben al arca desesperados, antes de que el mundo se ahogue.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un hombre cegado por unos residuos tóxicos, que también han potenciado el resto de sus sentidos, lucha contra el crimen como un acrobático superhéroe de las artes marciales.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Elektra tras recuperarse de las mortales heridas sufridas en "Daredevil", se convierte en la más peligrosa asesina del mundo.

programme.title: Tormenta terrestre
programme.desc: Un asteroide golpea el lado oscuro de la luna, desencadenando cambios climáticos en la tierra.

programme.title: Flood
programme.desc: Cuando una tormenta embravecida desata una marea colosal en la costa inglesa, el ingeniero marino Robert Morrison y su padre Leonard deben trabajar junto con Sam la ex esposa de Rob para salvar Londres antes de que las aguas abrumen a la ciudad.

programme.title: Flood
programme.desc: Cuando una tormenta embravecida desata una marea colosal en la costa inglesa, el ingeniero marino Robert Morrison y su padre Leonard deben trabajar junto con Sam la ex esposa de Rob para salvar Londres antes de que las aguas abrumen a la ciudad.

programme.title: Shark Week
programme.desc: Un grupo de completos extraños se encuentran aislados por un loco rico en el complejo de su isla. Se ven obligados a entrar en un guantelete espantoso donde deben sobrevivir a un aluvión de especies de tiburones cada vez más letales.

programme.title: Donnie Darko
programme.desc: Un adolescente con problemas tiene visiones de un hombre con un gran traje de conejo que lo manipula para cometer una serie de crímenes, después de que escapa por poco de un extraño accidente.

programme.title: La Fuente de la Vida
programme.desc: Con las actuaciones de Hugh Jackman y Rachel Weisz, se entreteje un cuento acerca de la búsqueda de un hombre por encontrar "el árbol de la vida" que le dará vida eterna.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia cree que tiene un fantasma inofensivo en su casa hasta que comienza a amenazar a los niños. No queriendo dejar que el mal gane, la familia recurre a la Iglesia Católica para expulsar al demonio.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una madre y una hija saben que su casa está encantada. Pero mientras la madre cree que es el espíritu de su novio asesinado, su hija cree que es mucho más oscuro.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El fantasma de un adolescente atormentado rompe la serenidad de una familia joven poco después de mudarse a su primera casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Angela, una recién casada, está emocionada de comenzar su nueva vida con Stephen cuando las pesadillas recurrentes que experimentó cuando era niña resurgen repentinamente. Pronto, la vieja y amenazadora bruja de sus sueños invade sus horas de vigilia.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Todo parece ir por buen camino cuando Sidney traslada a su novia embarazada a la casa que comparte con su madre. Pero su felicidad se rompe repentinamente cuando la familia comienza a experimentar eventos perturbadores.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Carl Johnson comienza a usar un tablero espiritual con sus hermanos, Keith y Cynthia, para comunicarse con el espíritu que acecha su hogar.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando el esposo bombero de Jeanette muere en el cumplimiento del deber, ella recurre a su indomable espíritu neoyorquino y traslada a sus hijas a una aldea rústica en Long Island para comenzar de nuevo. Pero su refugio rural resulta todo menos idílico.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Joy, una madre trabajadora de tres hijos, asume que el fin de semana de una niña en una plantación encantada será un cambio de ritmo agradable.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Angelina Balistreri cree que su hogar está perseguido por un fantasma inofensivo, mientras que su esposo, Emiliano, se muestra escéptico ante lo paranormal.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Después de que su madre, Linda, regresa de un viaje rutinario al extranjero a la India, Kara Dravis comienza a experimentar sucesos inexplicables y aterradores en su casa que la llevan a creer que está encantada.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Los sonidos extraños y las sensaciones espeluznantes llevan a Charles Gonzales a sospechar que un espíritu acecha su hogar en Florida.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Jeanette Osborne se regala un juego de máscaras haitianas para decorar la casa de sus sueños en California que comparte con su esposo Bob Griffith y su hijo Grier de 12 años.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Desde que tiene memoria, Markie Beason ha sentido una presencia en su casa. Si bien su familia cree que es solo su imaginación, Markie está más segura de que su casa está encantada a medida que los espíritus centran su atención en ella.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando muere el amado padre de Phil Pritchard, cae en una profunda depresión que lo vuelve vulnerable a un mal sobrenatural que comienza a influir en él y no se detendrá ante nada para convertirlo en un peón en su incansable sed de miseria y asesinato.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Tracey Berrios experimenta una actividad paranormal dentro de su nuevo hogar, sospecha que hay espíritus vinculados a la historia de la casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Tammy Shea, madre soltera de tres hijos, traslada a su familia para comenzar de nuevo, pero su sueño se convierte en una pesadilla cuando su familia se enfrenta a múltiples entidades.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Deborah Utley comienza a experimentar eventos paranormales en su hogar, recurre a su fe en busca de protección.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La sesión de espiritismo de Sam Baltrusis lo deja poseído y desesperado por estar a salvo. Un chamán lucha contra el espíritu, para que Sam pueda recuperar el control de su vida.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando una pareja trae un gabinete antiguo a su casa de Tennessee, comienzan a suceder eventos inexplicables. Buscando una respuesta, instalaron una cámara de vigilancia y capturaron pruebas de que el gabinete es la fuente de la actividad paranormal.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una mujer hace el desgarrador descubrimiento de que su nuevo hogar alberga un portal paranormal.

programme.title: Juan Colorado
programme.desc: El norteño Juan, se enamora de la machorra Silvia, pero, su padre la quiere casar con un tal Rafael, el cual por celos y envidia, se une al padre de Silvia, para acabar con Juan. Ella al darse cuenta de lo que sucede, se viste como Juan para salvarlo.

programme.title: Juana Gallo
programme.desc: La verdadera historia de Angela Ramos, una joven campesina que llegó a ser la cabeza de una guerrilla que luchó exitosamente contra las fuerzas federales del usurpador Victoriano Huerta. El pueblo la llamó por su fiereza “Juana Gallo”.

programme.title: La Hermana Trinquete
programme.desc: Elena es una escurridiza ladrona y artista del disfraz. Al verse perseguida por la policía se disfraza de monja y decide refugiarse en un convento.

programme.title: La Loca
programme.desc: Un joven psiquiatra se interesa en el caso de una paciente que cree vivir en el año 1936. Los parientes de ella quieren hacerla pasar por sana para poder cobrar una herencia de pero el médico lucha contra toda la familia para defender a 'La loca'.

programme.title: La Mujer de Oro
programme.desc: Una empleada bancaria huye con el dinero que robó a través de un túnel.

programme.title: La Vida de Pedro Infante
programme.desc: Una historia emotiva y tierna basada en la vida real de Pedro Infante, el cantante y actor más famoso de México. Sus comienzos, sus triunfos, su pasión por los aviones, sus amores y su trágica muerte en plena flor de su edad.

programme.title: La edad de la tentación
programme.desc: La negligencia de los padres que no asumen su responsabilidad en la educación sexual de los hijos provoca la ruina de muchas vidas.

programme.title: La flecha envenenada
programme.desc: Una joven huérfana es atacada por apaches y debe pagar las deudas de su padre, ya que puede ser despojada de sus tierras.

programme.title: Los alegres aguilares
programme.desc: El aventurero Manuel se encuentra con Carlos, quien es casi idéntico a él. Uno es de familia rica y el otro no. Entonces Manuel le ofrece dinero a Carlos para que se haga pasar por él con una señorita con la cual no se quiere casar.

programme.title: Los bandidos
programme.desc: Tres bandidos mexicanos huyen de los franceses internándose en Estados Unidos dónde salvan de la horca a tres bandoleros estadounidenses, junto a los que deciden robarles un tesoro a los franceses.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey hace una convocatoria a los padres y estudiantes de la primaria de South Park para anunciar que la directora Victoria ha sido despedida, siendo reemplazada por el director PC.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La ciudad de South Park está en crisis y Kenny piensa que es hora de conseguir un trabajo.

programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park

programme.desc: Las niñas asiáticas de la escuela están dibujando imágenes románticas al estilo manga de Tweek y Craig, creando una gran confusión entre los alumnos y los padres.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras Kenny y los chicos juegan a ser ninjas, todos en South Park empiezan a creer que en realidad forman parte de una organización terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El director PC está extremadamente furioso con uno de sus alumnos, Jimmy Valmer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El director PC desaparece con dos estudiantes de cuarto grado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La desconfianza entre Kyle y Stan ha roto su amistad, y Kyle se ha arrojado en una peligrosa alianza.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos deciden que tienen que acabar con Cartman porque están convencidos de que él es el Troll. Mientras tanto, el padre de Kyle logra mantener en secreto su identidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: A medida que continúa su asedio virtual a todos, Gerald está encantado con la atención de los medios.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se unen para protestar por sus derechos mostrando algunas partes de sus cuerpos sin ropa.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Gran Basura desiste de la carrera por la presidencia. Mientras tanto, Gerald (CazaPutas42) lucha con los demás Trolls para detener el movimiento antitroll de Dinamarca.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una ciudad entera en Colorado es hackeada. Gerald y Cartman pueden perderlo todo cuando la historia de su actividad en Internet se hace pública.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Garrison, que recientemente recibió la apariencia de Donald Trump, ha sido electo como nuevo presidente de los Estados Unidos. Gerald intenta escapar del temido cazador de trolls danés.

programme.title: South Park

programme.desc: Una apuesta iniciada porque Cartman vio a un duende es el inicio de un problema, aunado a que los chicos se encuentran frente a la totalidad imaginativa del mundo atacada por un grupo terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos intentan cruzar al elefante de Kyle con ''Fofa'', la cerda de Cartman, para un experimento genético de la escuela con el cual intentan ganarle a Terrance. Mientras, Stan lucha contra los abusos físicos de su hermana, Shelly.
programme.sub-title: Un elefante hace el amor con una cerda

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman consigue ganar dinero subiendo videos de unos bebés peleando por una pelotita de crack. Kyle piensa que eso es malo hasta que Cartman lo convence de que no es así.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le insiste a sus amigos que los ataques terroristas del 11 de Septiembre fueron una conspiración y se dispone a desenmascarar la verdad. Por su parte, el Sr. Mackey quiere saber quién defecó en el baño.

programme.title: The Dead Girl ES
programme.desc: El asesinato de una joven reúne las historias de cinco mujeres: Lonely Arden descubre el cuerpo, Leah cree que la víctima puede ser su hermana desaparecida. Melora cree que es su hija, mientras que Ruth hace un descubrimiento aterrador.

programme.title: La caza
programme.desc: Tras un divorcio difícil, Lucas, de cuarenta años, ha conocido a otra mujer, tiene un nuevo trabajo y se dispone a reconstruir la relación con Marcus, su hijo adolescente. Pero algo va mal. Un detalle. Un comentario inocente. Una mentira fortuita.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: Un cuento de Navidad
programme.desc: Un viejo avaro amargado tiene la oportunidad de redimirse cuando se ve acechado por fantasmas en Nochebuena.

programme.title: Love After Love
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su padre, dos hijos se enfrentan a las pruebas de sus propias vidas mientras ven a su madre explorar sus propios comienzos.

programme.title: Recuerdo
programme.desc: Gordon inventa la máquina "Rememory" que le permite ver los recuerdos tal y como fueron en realidad.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: En Montreal, Jeffrey está a punto de cerrar otro negocio. Su esposa Marianne se siente frustrada por no poder ser madre. En la ciudad, vive Lucky, que está casado con Phyllis. Cuando Marianne contrata a Lucky, la vida de los 4 dará un giro.

programme.title: Sí quiero, pero no quiero
programme.desc: Lauren, una joven divorciada que trabaja organizando bodas, se enamora del novio de una de sus clientas.

programme.title: La segunda oportunidad
programme.desc: Una madre divorciada intenta hacer las paces con su disfuncional familia encontrando una segunda oportunidad en el amor.

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: En 1943, en la Noruega ocupada por Alemania, un grupo de saboteadores es traicionado y apresado por las tropas nazis. De los 12 integrantes del comando, sólo uno consigue sobrevivir.

programme.title: El último hijo
programme.desc: El forajido Isaac LeMay está en las últimas, perseguido como un perro. Está dispuesto a acabar con todo, pero su maldición permanece. Su hijo Cal es aún peor que él, y deja un reguero de sangre y destrucción por donde pasa.

programme.title: Nacido campeón
programme.desc: Mickey que dejar atrás todo lo que ama para participar en un torneo clandestino de MMA

programme.title: El ladrón de Shanghai
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de un maestro en artes marciales, un intrépido joven se hace pasar por un príncipe llegado de un lejano país para poder casarse con la hija del Rey y aspirar al trono.

programme.title: Fillers Pluto TV ES
programme.desc: Fillers Pluto TV ES

programme.title: Valentine: venganza oscura
programme.desc: Una joven se involucra con un hombre con la idea de que va a hacer una película cuando lo que él pretende es convertirla en vigilante enmascarada.

programme.title: CAT. 8
programme.desc: Con la esperanza de presentar un sistema de defensa global fiable, una científica desencadena un desastre magnético.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: James Hunt y Niki Lauda, dos pilotos de Fórmula 1 extremadamente hábiles, mantienen entre sí una intensa rivalidad. Sin embargo, es su enemistad lo que les lleva al límite.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: El hermano de un hombre que ha fingido su muerte y robado un monton de dinero de una banda, trata de descubrir la verdad y encontrar a su asesino.

programme.title: El valor del honor
programme.desc: Castigado por su alcoholismo y rebeldía, un joven blanco (Charlie Sheen) es enviado a una prisión militar repleta de reclusos negros liderados por Stokes (Laurence Fishburne) y supervisados por un sargento sádico (Martin Sheen).

programme.title: Bienvenido A Hamburgo
programme.desc: En su primera misión en Investigación Criminal, Nick Tschiller descubre un piso usado para explotar a menores. Un violento tiroteo acaba con la muerte de tres miembros del Clan Astan, desatando un peligroso conflicto.

programme.title: Con la magia en los zapatos
programme.desc: Un zapatero, aburrido de su vida cotidiana, tropieza con una reliquia mágica que le permite convertirse en otras personas y ver el mundo de otra manera.

programme.title: Memoria Perdida
programme.desc: Un periodista con pérdida de memoria regresa a su pueblo natal y se reencuentra con su tío y antiguo amor.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: Basada en la novela de Francisco de Paula. Un grupo de adolescentes castigados en el instituto descubre la amistad y el amor mientras comparten sus problemas. En elenco podemos ver a Ivana Baquero, Patrick Criado, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón o Raúl Arévalo.

programme.title: Tipos Legales
programme.desc: Val (Al Pacino) sale de la cárcel tras cumplir 28 años de condena. Doc (Christopher Walken), su mejor amigo, le espera a la salida para ir a ver a Hirsch (Alan Arkin), otro viejo colega.

programme.title: Con la magia en los zapatos
programme.desc: Un zapatero, aburrido de su vida cotidiana, tropieza con una reliquia mágica que le permite convertirse en otras personas y ver el mundo de otra manera.

programme.title: Las Aventuras De Moriana
programme.desc: Después de un aviso de desalojo, Moriana, una madre con tres hijos, se adelanta a la vida y comienza un negocio de restaurante que no funciona.

programme.title: Andrea y Lorenzo
programme.desc: Andrea es una periodista, pero siente que su vida es estática. Lorenzo, un compañero y amante del pasado, se ha transformado en un rockstar famoso y enseñará a Andrea sobre el amor, vida, y como ser fiel a sí misma.

programme.title: El tutor
programme.desc: Exprisidario Ray Bradstone está tratando de encontrar un trabajo honrado. El jefe de una banda de ladrones de bancos le propone un último trabajo. Al principio acepta, pero cambia de opinión y decide acompañar a su hija a una excursión de la escuela.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres. Pronto se embarcarán en una misión suicida para volar un puente.

programme.title: El Ataque de los Tomates Asesinos
programme.desc: Los tomates, hartos de tantos años de acabar como sofrito o Bloody Mary, están cobrando vida y están asesinando a los humanos.

programme.title: Amor a quemarropa
programme.desc: En Detroit, un friki de la cultura pop se casa con una puta, le roba cocaína a su chulo, e intenta venderla en Hollywood. Los propietarios de la coca les siguen la pista para recuperarla.

programme.title: En lo profundo del bosque
programme.desc: Tommaso, un niño de 4 años, desaparece durante un festival. Cinco años después, encontraron a un niño sin nombre y sin documentos. Coincidencias de ADN: él es Tommi, pero su madre se pregunta si ese niño no es realmente su hijo.

programme.title: El general murió al amanecer
programme.desc: En los años 30, en plena guerra civil china, el aventurero O'Hara, indignado por el trato que el general Yang dispensa a sus compatriotas, envía dinero al señor Wu para que compre en Shangai armas.

programme.title: Breve encuentro
programme.desc: Adaptación televisiva de la obra de Noël Coward. Un hombre y una mujer no pueden evitar enamorarse.

programme.title: El gran golpe
programme.desc: Una banda liderada por Macao Park planea un gran golpe en un casino. Pero sin honor entre ladrones, cada uno trama su propio plan para quedarse con el botín.

programme.title: El Arco
programme.desc: Un pescador protege en el mar a la joven que recogió de niña, esperando casarse a sus 17. Usa su arco como arma, música y oráculo. La llegada de un universitario enamora a la chica, acabando el sueño del anciano.

programme.title: Hierro 3
programme.desc: Tae-suk, que okupa casas, encuentra a Sun-hwa, maltratada por su marido. Ella se une a su vida errante hasta que son descubiertos. Tras ser encarcelado, él la busca para recuperarla.

programme.title: The Dead Girl ES
programme.desc: El asesinato de una joven reúne las historias de cinco mujeres: Lonely Arden descubre el cuerpo, Leah cree que la víctima puede ser su hermana desaparecida. Melora cree que es su hija, mientras que Ruth hace un descubrimiento aterrador.

programme.title: Herencia de sangre
programme.desc: Verity recibe la triste noticia de que su padre ha muerto de un ataque al corazón y regresa a su hogar en su extensa propiedad de Nueva Orleans. Allí, conocerá la herencia de su padre.

programme.title: Cut Bank
programme.desc: Dwayne, un joven que fue atleta estrella y que ahora trabaja como mecánico, sueña con irse de la población de Cut Bank - la ciudad más fría de los EE.UU. - y mudarse a la gran ciudad, llevándose consigo a su novia Cassandra, que sueña con ser modelo.

programme.title: La decisión de Sophie
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...

programme.title: Gracias a Dios
programme.desc: Alexandre vive en Lyon con su esposa e hijos. Por casualidad, se entera de que el sacerdote que abusó de él cuando era un boy scout sigue trabajando con niños. Se lanza a un combate al que se unen otras víctimas del sacerdote…

programme.title: Corazón Silencioso
programme.desc: Tres generaciones de una familia se reúnen un fin de semana. Las hermanas, Sanne y Heidi, han aceptado que su madre, enferma terminal, quiera poner fin a su vida antes de que su estado empeore.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Un día, a Tom Avery (Martín Sheen), un reputado oftalmólogo viudo, le comunican que su hijo Daniel, con el que nunca ha tenido buenas relaciones, ha muerto en los Pirineos durante un temporal.

programme.title: La perfecta desconocida

programme.title: Fear X

programme.title: Barba azul

programme.title: Dorian Gray

programme.title: La Casa Roja
programme.desc: Un anciano y su hermana ocultan un terrible secreto a su hija adolescente adoptiva, sobre una granja abandonada escondida, ubicada en lo profundo del bosque.

programme.title: La fugitiva

programme.title: El malvado Zaroff

programme.title: Un cubo de sangre
programme.desc: Un ayudante de camarero tonto es aclamado como artista por un gato muerto cubierto de yeso que se confunde con una hábil estatuilla. El deseo de más elogios pronto conduce a una serie de obras cada vez más mortales.

programme.title: Ausentes
programme.desc: Julia y Samuel se mudan con los niños a una urbanización en las afueras de la ciudad. Parece un lugar ideal, pero Julia pronto descubrirá que tan idílico paraje esconde algo extraño. Se da cuenta de que la urbanización está completamente desierta.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 1

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 2

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 3

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 4
programme.desc: Un anciano planifica usar alguno de los superpoderes de Curtis para regresar en el tiempo y asesinar a Hitler. Pero el plan sienta mal y la banda se dan cuentan en un mundo alternativo.

programme.title: Mutante X

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Eckhart busca un mutante que pueda absorber energía, uno con el que Brennan se involucre románticamente.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Un niño que está desarrollando nuevas habilidades mutantes ha sido secuestrado y el equipo accede a buscarlo para su madre. Más tarde se enteran de que fue ella quien secuestró a su hijo.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Struggling new attorney Rudy Baylor (Matt Damon) resorts to working for a shady lawyer (Mickey Rourke), where he meets paralegal Deck Shifflet (Danny DeVito). When the insurance company of Dot Black (Mary Kay Place) refuses her dying son coverage, Baylor and Shifflet team up to fight the corrupt corporation, taking on its callous lawyer (Jon Voight). Meanwhile, Baylor becomes involved with Kelly Riker (Claire Danes), an abused wife, whose husband complicates matters when he confronts Baylor.

programme.title: Changing Lanes
programme.desc: A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost.

programme.title: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: As death row inmate Matthew Poncelet (Sean Penn) nears his execution date, he calls upon Sister Helen Prejean (Susan Sarandon) to help him with one last appeal, maintaining that he is innocent of the murders of a young couple. Poncelet begins to form a bond with Prejean, and she visits both his family and the relatives of the victims, hoping to learn more about the case. As things begin to look bleak for Poncelet, Prejean does all that she can to comfort and console the hardened convict.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Scientist Karen Ross (Laura Linney) is sent by her father-in-law, mogul R.B. Travis (Joe Don Baker), to the Congo to determine the whereabouts of his son's missing diamond-hunting team. Led by expert guide Kelly (Ernie Hudson), Ross and a mismatched search party -- including primatologist Dr. Peter Elliot (Dylan Walsh), treasure hunter Herkermer Homolka (Tim Curry) and a gorilla -- discover a danger far more sinister than anything they expected to find, even in the heart of the jungle.

programme.title: Random Hearts

programme.title: All The King's Men

programme.title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
programme.desc: An undead Count falls in love with a woman, a dead ringer for his true love who perished centuries earlier.

programme.title: Straw Dogs
programme.desc: In a rural town, a young couple fights for survival when they're marked for death by locals.

programme.title: A Man for All Seasons
programme.desc: When the highly respected British statesman Sir Thomas More (Paul Scofield) refuses to pressure the Pope into annulling the marriage of King Henry VIII (Robert Shaw) and his Spanish-born wife, More's clashes with the monarch increase in intensity. A devout Catholic, More stands by his religious principles and moves to leave the royal court. Unfortunately, the King and his loyalists aren't appeased by this, and press forward with grave charges of treason, further testing More's resolve.

programme.title: 5 Against the House
programme.desc: When college buddies Ronnie (Kerwin Mathews) and Roy (Alvy Moore) are briefly detained by the Reno police in association with a casino robbery, Ronnie becomes obsessed with figuring out how to plan the perfect heist. At first, it is a strictly intellectual exercise, but when the emotionally disturbed Korean War vet Brick (Brian Keith) gets involved, the friends -- including straitlaced Al (Guy Madison) and his nightclub-singer girlfriend, Kaye (Kim Novak) -- have to pull the job for real.

programme.title: Good Neighbor Sam
programme.desc: Sam Bissell is an advertising executive who loves his wife, Min, and his family as much as he loves peace and quiet. When Janet Lagerlof, an old acquaintance, inherits a sizable fortune, Bissell is talked into pretending to be her husband in order to fulfill a legal requirement. Things get even more complicated when Ms. Lagerlof is introduced to Bissell's employer, Simon Nurdlinger, as Mrs. Bissell.

programme.title: American Madness

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck Trio, Cannonball Adderley Quintet, Charles Mingus Sextet & Jimmy Smith
programme.sub-title: Smith, Adderley, Brubeck, Mingus - Newport Jazz F.
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In October 1972, an outstanding lineup played shoulder-to-shoulder at the 7th Newport Jazz Festival held in Rotterdam's then-recently built concert venue De Doelen. These four masterful groups consisted of alto saxophonist "Cannonball" Adderley and his quintet (Nat Adderley on cornet, George Duke on keyboards, Walter Booker on bass, and Roy McCurdy on drums), Hammond organist Jimmy Smith and his band (Art Farmer on flugelhorn, Illinois Jacquet on tenor saxophone, Kenny Burrell on guitar, Clark Terry on trumpet, and Roy Haynes on drums), pianist Dave Brubeck and his trio (Jack Six on bass, Alan Dawson on drums) with accompaniment from Paul Desmond on alto saxophone and Gerry Mulligan on baritone saxophone, and bassist Charles Mingus and his group (Joe Gardner on trumpet, Hamiet Bluiett on baritone saxophone, John Foster on piano, Roy Brooks on drums) with the great high-note trumpeter Cat Anderson as a guest.

programme.title: Fabio Luisi, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & In Mo Yang
programme.sub-title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini's Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms' dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. Paganini's concerto dates from the mid-to-late 1810s, written as the composer was touring Italy with his remarkable violin technique. This piece is a quintessential expression of Paganini's extraordinary skill and ability, demanding much from the soloist. It is also characterized by the notably operatic “bel canto” style adopted by many of the composer's contemporaries, including Gioachino Rossini. This exceptional performance features the dazzling virtuosity of violinist In Mo Yang, winner of the 2015 Paganini Competition. It was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Frans Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus, Siobhan Stagg & Avery Amereau
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Klaus Tönshoff, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & DR Big Band
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus Tönshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema. Norwegian mezzosoprano Tuva Semmingsen sings ‘Diamonds Are A Girl's Best Friend', from Gentlemen Prefer Blondes, ‘My Favorite Things' from The Sound of Music, ‘Over the Rainbow' from The Wizard of Oz, ‘Moon River' from Breakfast at Tiffany's, and many other unforgettable hits. This concert performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2020.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers

This would prove to be the last recorded footage of long time drummer Keith Knudsen performing with the Doobie Brothers prior to his sad death from cancer in February 2005.

programme.sub-title: Live At The Royal Albert Hall
