programme.title: Malta Story
programme.desc: Peter Ross, a World War II pilot photographer, is forced to land in Malta.

programme.title: Nine Men
programme.desc: Sergeant Watson listened to the grumbles of his men, who had been going through a day's heavy training.

programme.title: Old Bill and Son
programme.desc: Bill has grumbled his way through WWI. Now it is WWII and, jealous of his son, he decides to enlist.

programme.title: Ships with Wings
programme.desc: A story of the courage and self-sacrifice shown by the men of the Fleet Air Arm during the Second World War.

programme.title: NYC: Tornado Terror
programme.desc: (2008) Disaster film starring Sebastian Spence. When a deadly jet stream vortex unleashes tornadoes over Manhattan, a race begins to stop the storm before the city is torn apart.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: (1963) Western starring John Wayne, Maureen O'Hara and Patrick Wayne. A wealthy rancher must navigate warring factions in the Wild West while also fighting to save his troubled marriage.

programme.title: Kentucky Rifle
programme.desc: (1955) Suspenseful western with Chill Wills, Lance Fuller and Cathy Downs. When a gun-filled wagon breaks down in enemy territory, will its occupants surrender their cargo or fight for their lives?

programme.title: War of the Wildcats
programme.desc: (1943) Classic western starring John Wayne. A tough cowboy and rich oil baron fight for power, land and love in 1900s Oklahoma. Who will triumph in this explosive battle of wills?

programme.title: JFK
programme.desc: John F. Kennedy in Dallas, Texas, in 1963. What he learns leads him to suspect that there is more to the story than the public is being told.

programme.title: Warrior
programme.desc: The youngest son (Hardy) of an alcoholic former boxer (Nolte) returns home, where he's trained by his father for competition in a mixed martial arts tournament -- a path that puts the fighter on a collision corner with his older brother (Edgerton).

programme.title: The Pink Panther 2
programme.desc: When legendary treasures from around the world are stolen, including the priceless Pink Panther diamond, Clouseau is assigned to a dream team of international detectives who are under pressure to bring the master thief to justice before he strikes again.

programme.title: Love Sarah
programme.desc: Three generations of women, led by Mimi will need to overcome grief, doubts and differences to honour the memory of their beloved Sarah, while embarking on a journey to establish a new bakery in Notting Hill, a place filled with love, hope and colourful pastries from all over the world.

programme.title: A Clear Shot
programme.desc: A hostage situation at the Good Guys electronic store in Sacramento California goes awry when bullets start flying. Will law enforcement be able to come in and save the day or will the hostage takers win. Contains strong language, violence and threat.

programme.title: Dreamchild
programme.desc: Ian Holm stars as the children's author Lewis Carroll in a touching fantasy-drama set in 1930s New York, featuring amazing special effects creatures from Muppet creator Jim Henson.

programme.title: A Stork's Journey
programme.desc: Richard is a sparrow. Orphaned at birth and raised by storks, he believes that he is a stork, too! But when winter comes and his adoptive flock prepare to migrate to Africa, his true identity is revealed and his family must leave him behind in the forest with the other sparrows. Determined to prove he is a stork after all, Richard ventures south on an epic adventure, accompanied by friends big and small, to unleash his true potential and be reunited with his family.

programme.title: Captain Sharky
programme.desc: Pint-sized swashbuckler Captain Sharky thinks he's the most dangerous pirate on the Seven Seas. To prove his bravery, he sets sail with Mikey, a well-behaved boy whose life Sharky has turned upside down, and Bonnie, a trouble-shooting girl who tends to assume command in every situation. This motley crew sails for big adventures as they thwart the plans of The Admiral and Old Bill the Pirate.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: When his family goes on vacation, a young dog finds himself at a dog prison where he must escape with the help of his new friends.

programme.title: Taking Sides
programme.desc: After the end of World War II, a famous German conductor is accused of loyalty to the Nazi regime. He argues that art and politics are separate. An investigator thinks otherwise.

programme.title: Uptown Girls (2003)
programme.desc: Molly Gunn is the daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of New York City. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job. Molly becomes a nanny to a girl, who is "eight going on forty."

programme.title: Hurricane Season
programme.desc: In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, high school basketball coach Al Collins assembles students from five different Louisiana schools and leads them all the way to the state championships.

programme.title: Empire Records
programme.desc: A group of young, anti-establishment Gen-X employees fight to save their record store from being overtaken by a conglomerate retail record corporation.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: To pay for his daughter's surgery, a card dealer teams up with a co-worker to pull off a casino heist.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: The world's authority on structural security accepts a job to break out of an ultra-secret, high-tech facility

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: A journalist, cameraman and war correspondent embark on a mission to find the No.1 war criminal in Bosnia.

programme.title: The Family
programme.desc: A notorious Mafia clan is relocated to Normandy, where fitting in soon becomes challenging.

programme.title: Last Days in the Desert
programme.desc: As Jesus begins his journey out of the wilderness following forty days of fasting and praying, he struggles with the Devil over the fate of a family in crisis. This powerful drama depicting an imagined chapter from Jesus' life stars Golden Globe winner Ewan McGregor (Trainspotting, Star Wars franchise), Academy Award nominee Ciarn Hinds (Belfast, Game of Thrones), and Tye Sheridan (Mud, X-Men franchise).

programme.title: The Nutcracker Sweet
programme.desc: It is Christmas Eve and the Silberhaus children are excited for the festivities to begin. Marie and Fritz are playing in the children's room when their godfather Drosselmayer arrives and presents them with an early Christmas gift, a Nutcracker. Marie witnesses a great battle between a vast army of toy soldiers led by the Nutcracker against a terrible platoon of mice commanded by the Mouse King. Follow Marie and Fritz's journey in the Kingdom of Dolls, through the Christmas Forest, past the Almond Milk Sea, and the Palace of the Marzipans.

programme.title: Benji's Very Own Christmas Story
programme.desc: On a surprise visit to meet Kris Kringle, Benji and his friends are shocked to discover that he plans to take the night off on Christmas Eve!

programme.title: 12 Dogs of Christmas 2: Great Puppy Rescue
programme.desc: In this heartwarming sequel to the holiday classic, Emma (Danielle Chuchran) rallies her friends new and old to save a beloved puppy orphanage by putting on a musical holiday extravaganza.

programme.title: My First Miracle
programme.desc: This is the story of Angelica, a 16 year-old girl who's battling a rare kind of cancer called Myelodysplastic Syndrome, her struggles to try to live a normal life, and her hopes of finding her first true love before it's too late.

programme.title: Can't Come Out To Play
programme.desc: A disturbing, skin-crawling horror thriller, featuring a stand-out performance from Michael Shannon (The Iceman) and directed by John McNaughton (Wild Things). A mentally unstable physician (Samantha Morton: Minority Report) keeps her dying son secluded from the outside world in a bid to preserve his life. Experience this chilling, psychological horror about a mother's obsessive love. A must see!

programme.title: The Triangle
programme.desc: In the summer of 2012, a group of four filmmakers receives a cryptic postcard from their friend, Nathaniel, who's been AWOL for more than three years. Despite the misgivings of one of the filmmakers, the group heads to Montana to answer Nathaniel's plea for help. With cameras rolling, the filmmakers set off to capture life inside what is either a harmless commune or something much more sinister

programme.title: It Had to Be You
programme.desc: Quirky, inventive and thoroughly romantic! Surprised by a sudden proposal and subsequent ultimatum from her easy-going boyfriend, Sonia, (Cristin Milioti: How I Met Your Mother, The Wolf of Wall Street) has to decide whether she'll join the ranks of her married friends or take a leap of faith and pursue her fantasies. A whimsical and touching romantic comedy that is delightful through and through!

programme.title: The Resistance
programme.desc: Compassionate, harrowing and full of unexpected humour, this is the incredible telling of a largely unknown chapter of the Jewish resistance. While the Nazi regime celebrate the capital of the Reich free of Jews, they are unaware of a group who have escaped. Hidden in their various guises we follow the journey of four Jews as they survive, while hiding in plain sight of the enemy.

programme.title: Arbitrage
programme.desc: When we first meet New York hedge fund magnate Robert Miller (Richard Gere), he appears the very portrait of success in American business and family life.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: Ex-felon, Eugene Brown, establishes a Chess Club for inner city teenagers in Washington, D.C.

programme.title: East of the Mountains
programme.desc: A retired heart surgeon with terminal cancer sets out on a final journey with his dog to his childhood home. When plans unravel, he's pulled into an unexpected adventure, facing life with wit, resilience, and a renewed sense of purpose.

programme.title: The Martini Shot
programme.desc: This existential comedy follows an ailing movie director as he shoots what he believes to be his final work of art. What starts out as a normal movie, ends up being an exploration of mortality and one's profound effect on the world.

programme.title: Northpole 2: Open For Christmas
programme.desc: (2015) Christmas drama starring Tiffani Thiessen. When a mum inherits a magical hotel, Santa sends an eager elf to lend a hand - and maybe sprinkle a little holiday magic along the way.

programme.title: Swept Up By Christmas
programme.desc: (2019) Festive rom com starring Lindy Booth and Justin Bruening. Tasked with downsizing a grand estate, what treasures will antiques dealer Gwen and cleaner Reed uncover in the run up to Christmas?

programme.title: Oh Christmas Tree
programme.desc: A family-run Christmas tree farm faces closure when a big city finance company threatens to buy it out in this family drama (2013)

programme.title: Spotlight on Christmas
programme.desc: A Hollywood actress returns to her hometown during the holidays after a public break-up. Once there, Olivia finally takes a starring role in her own life. Starring Tori Anderson (2020)

programme.title: Finding Santa
programme.desc: Grace faces a crisis organising this year's Christmas Parade when the town's Santa is injured. Can she convince Ben, who dislikes Christmas, to be her substitute Santa? Stars Jodie Sweetin. (2017)

programme.title: My Policeman
programme.desc: A tale of forbidden romance and changing social conventions, "My Policeman" follows the relationships between three people — policeman Tom, teacher Marion and museum curator Patrick — and their emotional and complex journey that spans decades.

programme.title: The Rewrite
programme.desc: Once upon a time, screenwriter Keith Michaels was on top of the world. But now, he's divorced, broke and hasn't written a hit film in years. His attitude slowly begins to turn when he meets Holly, a single mum.

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: Jenny Farrell has led an openly gay life - except with her conventional family. When she finally decides to start a family and marry the woman they thought was just her roommate, the small, safe world the Farrells inhabited changes forever.

programme.title: Meet Me in New York
programme.desc: Kelly is a young, creative, ambitious events planner in New York City and quickly gaining a reputation as one of the best in the business. But when Joe, an influential website editor, hires her to organize his niece's 10th birthday party, Kelly quickly realizes that she may have just met her match.

programme.title: The Vow
programme.desc: Real-life story of a newlywed New Mexico couple, Kim and Krickitt Carpenter, who were struck by tragedy shortly after their marriage. A car crash puts the wife in a coma, where she is cared for by her devoted husband.

programme.title: Christmas à la Carte
programme.desc: When food correspondent, CARLY, gets a shot at her own show nothing goes as planned. She's sent to Angel Heights to help GRANT, a chef, reopen her family's beloved diner and film it for her television show.

programme.title: At Sachem Farm
programme.desc: Ross plans to sell his family's wine collection to finance a mining interest, but standing in his way is Uncle Cullen, who has different plans for the family estate.

programme.title: Love Notes
programme.desc: Starring Laura Leighton and Antonio Cupo. When a classical music critic becomes pregnant from a brief encounter with a country music star, she decides it is the perfect way for her infertile best friend to have a baby.

programme.title: The Loss Adjuster
programme.desc: Hapless Insurance Loss Adjuster - Martin Dyer - feels his life is spiralling out of control but discovers that even when you reach rock bottom, that some clouds really do have a silver lining.

programme.title: My Perfect Romance
programme.desc: Robinson Tech is launching a new dating service that they ensure will find your Perfect Match. But when its's CEO and tech developer are challenged on Live TV to test the service themselves, the algorithm shows some interesting results.

programme.title: Runaway Romance
programme.desc: Reality TV star Ann Stanway leaves Hollywood and finds herself in Amish country where she discovers friendship, new love and ultimately herself. In the end, Ann must decide between staying in her newfound reality or returning to her old one.

programme.title: Prescription For Love
programme.desc: Claire, a nurse, fights for a chance at love with a charming new doctor and for a promotion to free herself from the misery her supervisor creates. As her supervisor tries to derail Claire's chance at happiness, Claire will have to stand up for herself and go after her dreams.

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: After winning a $50,000 prize, a man decides to pay things forward by buying Christmas gifts for strangers under the pseudonym "Lucky the Elf."

programme.title: Christmas Town.
programme.desc: Cynical workaholic suspects her dad's sudden switch to a Christmas-obsessed town.

programme.title: Four Christmases and a Wedding
programme.desc: Chloe (Arielle Kebbel) is hired to plan the local Christmas Festival.

programme.title: Eat, Drink and be Married
programme.desc: Billie helps save a wedding—and maybe finds love herself—in this charming romantic twist!

programme.title: His Secret Past
programme.desc: Popular crime novelist, Jennifer Becker lives a lavish life in a small coastal town in California with her daughter, Lily. One day, while out for a run, Lily is attacked--but then rescued by a mysterious stranger named Mick.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Blood Ties
programme.desc: Vicki has trouble building a case against Elana, a nightclub owner she knows is actually Medusa.

programme.title: Blood Ties
programme.desc: Vicki finds a necromancer and his assistant using dead athletes for a hideous underground sporting event.

programme.title: Major League: Back To The Minors
programme.desc: A pitcher is about to be put out to pasture when he is given the opportunity to manage a team.

programme.title: Guarding Tess
programme.desc: A beloved but cantankerous former First Lady engages in a battle of wills with her bodyguard.

programme.title: Year One
programme.desc: After eating from the Tree of Knowledge, a primitive villager/slacker flees his people and encounters murderous Cain, slave traders, charismatic nutcase Abraham, and finally the city of Sodom. There the man falls for a princess, is hailed as "the chosen" by the oppressed people and ultimately leads a revolt that topples the government and frees the slaves. He heads off with the princess to visit Egypt....

programme.title: How Do You Know?
programme.desc: Feeling a bit past her prime at 27, former athlete Lisa Jorgenson finds herself in the middle of a love triangle, as a corporate guy in crisis competes with Lisa's current, baseball-playing beau.

programme.title: Landscape With Invisible Hand
programme.desc: In the near future, when an occupying alien species' bureaucratic rule and advanced technology leaves most of Earth impoverished and unemployed, two teenagers hatch a risky plan to ensure their families' futures.

programme.title: India Sweets and Spices
programme.desc: When Alia returns home from university, she challenges her parents' elitist lifestyle expensive jewellery, lavish dinner parties, and gossiping aunties. But when she invites the son of a local shopkeeper to her mother's upcoming soiree, family secrets begin to surface.

programme.title: 36 Husbands
programme.desc: 36 Husbands is a mystical, musical, Kung Fu spy comedy starring 3 powerful women - and a bunch of husbands. Krista, top spy and Kung Fu master, has extraordinary powers and she puts them in action on her quest to slow down the steady march towards World War III.

programme.title: City Slacker
programme.desc: Amanda is a corporate high flier who needs a slacker so she can have a baby and keep her career.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Former CIA spy takes on his toughest assignment to date: looking after his girlfriend's three kids.

programme.title: The Son of Zorro
programme.desc: In imperial Mexico, nobleman Don Ricardo secretly fights as the Son of Zorro against corrupt Governor Leblanche. When rebels ambush a weapons transport, killing Don Herrera, Ricardo rescues his daughter Conchita and hides her, fueling a revolution for justice and freedom.

programme.title: The Cariboo Trail
programme.desc: Montanans Jim Redfern and Mike Evans head into Canada's British Columbia via the Cariboo Trail intent to raise cattle and dig for gold but find trouble instead.

programme.title: Gunman of Ave Maria
programme.desc: Mann is a gunman informed by a childhood friend that his father was murdered years earlier by his mother and her lover.

programme.title: In a Colt's Shadow
programme.desc: A story about two gunfighters, Duke and Steve. Steve is in love with Duke's daughter but Duke disapproves of the match, envisioning a life of hardship and danger for the girl if she marries Steve.

programme.title: Buckaroo: The Winchester Does Not Forgive
programme.desc: The Winchester Does Not Forgive - When the stagecoach in which they travel is attacked by Monteiro's gang, Lash accepts to kill his friend to save his bacon.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: The epic adventures of a man who discovers that he possesses the exhilarating ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world he can imagine.

programme.title: Programming will resume shortly
programme.desc: We're catching up on our beauty sleep! Stay tuned for more priceless entertainment curated by Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Lost Treasure of Jesse James
programme.desc: When their family homes are threatened by a local land developer, a group of youngsters set out to locate the mysterious James brothers' treasure, a legend that may just save Ford county and allow them to keep their family homes forever.

programme.title: Enemy Within
programme.desc: When a Japanese fighter pilot crash-lands on the tiny remote Hawaiian island of Ni'ihau, he is met with courtesy and traditional Hawaiian hospitality from the locals.

programme.title: Burying Yasmeen
programme.desc: One man's odyssey to put a ring on his dead ex-wife.

programme.title: Devil Doll
programme.desc: A guide leads Sydney and Nigel to an unusual, underground Aztec burial chamber. Instead of a body, they find a relic.

programme.title: Incognito
programme.desc: Retrieving a mythical lancet, Sydney and Nigel run into Nigel's look-alike just before his death. Nigel gets a cut from the lancet. Later, Cate persuades Nigel to impersonate the man.

programme.title: All Choked Up
programme.desc: Carson Inez, a collector, uses an ancient necklace to get Sydney to help her in raising Athena who will then help her conquer the world.

programme.title: Warlock of Nu Theta Phi
programme.desc: When Sydney's student Meg's roommate finds a witch's amulet, it hospitalizes Meg. Meg's boyfriend's fraternity brother races to get the amulet. What is he up to?

programme.title: Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: While Sydney is lecturing about the Native Americans who faced a mysterious cataclysm 600 years earlier, a native brings her a relic from that era. What is its secret?

programme.title: Hunting with the Enemy
programme.desc: An urn commissioned in a Cambodian monastery by the Chinese emperor for the remains of Confucius is about to be destroyed by systematic bombing of a whole province.

programme.title: Under the Ice
programme.desc: Despite terrible weather, Sidney drags Nigel along to an Arctic base where an ancient Indian mummy has been found, who turns out to be an Anasazi.

programme.title: Antianeirai
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel travel to Istanbul to investigate the death of one Sydney's friends, a professor who was trying to prove Hercules did exist by finding the Belt of Hippolyte.

programme.title: Silverado
programme.desc: Four drifters arrive in a small frontier town and become unlikely heroes in a battle against a powerful family and a corrupt sheriff.

programme.title: Ivanhoe (1982)
programme.desc: Sir Walter Scott's epic novel of timeless romance and knightly daring comes to life! The year is 1194. At long last, the noble knight Wilfred of Ivanhoe (Anthony Andrews) has returned from the Crusades to regain his title and win the hand of his beloved Lady Rowena (Lysette Anthony).

programme.title: Krull
programme.desc: A young prince battles aliens and sorcerers to rescue his princess from the Beast on the fantastic planet Krull.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck Trio, Cannonball Adderley Quintet, Charles Mingus Sextet & Jimmy Smith
programme.sub-title: Smith, Adderley, Brubeck, Mingus - Newport Jazz F.
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In October 1972, an outstanding lineup played shoulder-to-shoulder at the 7th Newport Jazz Festival held in Rotterdam's then-recently built concert venue De Doelen. These four masterful groups consisted of alto saxophonist "Cannonball" Adderley and his quintet (Nat Adderley on cornet, George Duke on keyboards, Walter Booker on bass, and Roy McCurdy on drums), Hammond organist Jimmy Smith and his band (Art Farmer on flugelhorn, Illinois Jacquet on tenor saxophone, Kenny Burrell on guitar, Clark Terry on trumpet, and Roy Haynes on drums), pianist Dave Brubeck and his trio (Jack Six on bass, Alan Dawson on drums) with accompaniment from Paul Desmond on alto saxophone and Gerry Mulligan on baritone saxophone, and bassist Charles Mingus and his group (Joe Gardner on trumpet, Hamiet Bluiett on baritone saxophone, John Foster on piano, Roy Brooks on drums) with the great high-note trumpeter Cat Anderson as a guest.

programme.title: Fabio Luisi, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & In Mo Yang
programme.sub-title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini's Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms' dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. Paganini's concerto dates from the mid-to-late 1810s, written as the composer was touring Italy with his remarkable violin technique. This piece is a quintessential expression of Paganini's extraordinary skill and ability, demanding much from the soloist. It is also characterized by the notably operatic “bel canto” style adopted by many of the composer's contemporaries, including Gioachino Rossini. This exceptional performance features the dazzling virtuosity of violinist In Mo Yang, winner of the 2015 Paganini Competition. It was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Frans Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus, Siobhan Stagg & Avery Amereau
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Klaus Tönshoff, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & DR Big Band
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus Tönshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema. Norwegian mezzosoprano Tuva Semmingsen sings ‘Diamonds Are A Girl's Best Friend', from Gentlemen Prefer Blondes, ‘My Favorite Things' from The Sound of Music, ‘Over the Rainbow' from The Wizard of Oz, ‘Moon River' from Breakfast at Tiffany's, and many other unforgettable hits. This concert performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2020.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, "Live At Wolf Trap" captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks from across their extensive catalogue. This would prove to be the last recorded footage of long time drummer Keith Knudsen performing with the Doobie Brothers prior to his sad death from cancer in February 2005.

programme.title: Heart
programme.sub-title: Live At The Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: This film captures not only Heart's first-ever live performance at the Royal Albert Hall but is also the first concert film of Heart performing with a full orchestra. Live At The Royal Albert Hall With The Royal Philharmonic Orchestra includes chart-topping songs like “These Dreams”, “Alone”, “What About Love”, “Barracuda”, “Magic Man”, “Dreamboat Annie”, and more!

programme.title: Pauline en la playa
programme.desc: Pauline es una adolescente de quince años que pasa un verano en la costa atlántica francesa con su prima Marion. Marion se encuentra allí con Pierre, un antiguo amigo que se siente atraído por ella. Sin embargo, Marion prefiere al aventurero Henri, aunque sabe que su relación con él será efímera. Mientras, Pauline también inicia un romance.

programme.title: Madame de...
programme.desc: París, 1900, Madame Louise, mujer frívola y coqueta, necesita hacer frente a sus deudas, para lo cual decide vender en secreto unos valiosos pendientes que le había regalado su marido. Este sencillo acto provocará una dramática reacción en cadena. Los pendientes serán primero adquiridos por su propio marido como ofrenda a su amante, y posteriormente ella se deshará de ellos y acabarán en manos de un Barón italiano, quien, por azares del destino, acabará encontrándose en París con Madame de...

programme.title: La hierba errante
programme.desc: Una compañía de teatro llega a un pueblo de la costa sur de Japón, donde el director de la misma se reencuentra con su hijo no reconocido. El muchacho cree que el hombre es su tío y el director trata de recuperar el tiempo perdido. Su actual amante, la actriz protagonista, está celosa y le pide a una compañera que intente seducir al muchacho.

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: Los viajeros de la noche
programme.desc: Un joven cowboy, seducido por una chica nueva en la ciudad, descubre que ha sido mordido por un vampiro. Lentamente se convierte en una criatura de la noche alimentándose con la sangre de sus víctimas.

programme.title: Mi Amigo Dahmer
programme.desc: Jeffrey Dahmer asesinó a 17 hombres adultos y jóvenes en el Medio Oeste de Estados Unidos y se convirtió en uno de los asesinos en serie más abominables de la historia del país. Esta es la historia antes de esa historia.

programme.title: Duelo al sol
programme.desc: La hermosa mestiza Pearl Chavez se convierte en pupila del primer amor de su padre muerto.

programme.title: Donde está el Truco

programme.title: 97 Minutos
programme.desc: Un agente infiltrado es la única esperanza de un avión secuestrado a punto de estrellarse.

programme.title: Escribir lo Imposible
programme.desc: El escritor Juan Tallón revela cómo su libro predijo la fragilidad de la vida.

programme.title: Revuelo en las Aulas
programme.desc: Estudiantes de secundaria se unen contra la censura de un director opresivo.

programme.title: El Vendedor de Sueños
programme.desc: Un mendigo salva a un psiquiatra y se convierte en gurú viral, inspirando a muchos con su sabiduría.

programme.title: Cegados por el sol
programme.desc: Luca Guadagnino, el aclamado director de "Yo soy el amor", vuelve con una intenso thriller sexual protagonizado por Ralph Fiennes, Dakota Johnson, Matthias Schonaerts y Tilda Swinton.

programme.title: Amor y otras drogas
programme.desc: Maggie es una mujer independiente que no deja que nada le ate. Pero conoce a Jamie, cuyo encanto le sirve bien tanto con las mujeres como dentro del mundo de las farmacéuticas. La evolución que sufre su relación coge a ambos por sorpresa, al encontrarse bajo la influencia de la droga final: el amor.

programme.title: El Benefactor
programme.desc: La historia de un nostálgico filántropo (Richard Gere) que se involucra y se hace hueco en la vida de un matrimonio recién casado, Olivia (Dakota Fanning) y Luke (Theo James), buscando con ello recuperar experiencias vitales que antaño tuvo.

programme.title: La Directora de orquesta
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales. Cuenta la historia de Antonia Brico, una joven que sueña en convertirse en directora de orquesta, pero nadie la toma en serio por ser una mujer.

programme.title: El asesinato de John Lennon
programme.desc: Jared Leto engordó más de 20 kilos para interpretar la historia que retrata el trastornado estado mental de Chapman y el apego a la clásica novela "El Guardián entre el centeno" que finalmente le hizo perder el control de la realidad y llevar a cabo el infame asesinato que trastornó al mundo.

programme.title: El asesino de los postales
programme.desc: La hija del detective neoyorquino Jacob Kanon ha sido asesinada poco después de casarse. Cuando Kanon se entera de esta terrible noticia decide buscar al responsable del crimen a cualquier precio.

programme.title: Asuntos de familia
programme.desc: Nazaret en la actualidad: una pareja de ancianos vive cansada del ritmo de su rutina diaria. En el otro lado de la frontera, en Ramallah, su hijo desea seguir siendo un eterno soltero, su hija está a punto de dar a luz mientras el marido de esta consigue un papel en una película.

programme.title: Negación
programme.desc: Drama judicial basado en el libro 'History On Trial'. La película cuenta el juicio entre la autora del libro, Deborah E. Lipstadt, y David Irving, famoso periodista admirador de Hitler al que ella había acusado de negar el holocausto, motivo por el que él se querelló contra ella por difamaciones.

programme.title: El hombre más buscado
programme.desc: Sobria película de espías a la vieja escuela llena de tensión y suspense. Un joven ruso sin papeles consigue llegar a la ciudad de Hamburgo. Lleva encima una sorprendente cantidad de dinero. Annabel, una abogada defensora de derechos civiles, intenta que no lo deporten.

programme.title: Una sorpresa real
programme.desc: Cuando el novio de Riley la invita a Sudáfrica para conocer a su familia, ella se sorprende.

programme.title: Palm Swings
programme.desc: Tras mudarse a Palm Springs, un matrimonio pone a prueba su amor al descubrir que sus vecinos son swingers.

programme.title: La Ola Perfecta

programme.title: Para Toda la Vida

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Cuando el puente de San Luis se derrumba, los viajeros caen al abismo.

programme.title: Más fuerte que su destino
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XVI, las amantes de los hombres importantes de Venecia llevaban una vida muy majestuosa y se las animaba a leer y estudiar en una época en la que ese tipo de educación estaba prohibida para la mayoría de mujeres.

programme.title: Aire Libre
programme.desc: Una pareja que intenta balancear la vida, matrimonio, un hijo y haberse mudado a una casa nueva en las afueras de la ciudad.

programme.desc: Merab ha entrenado desde joven en el grupo de danza nacional de Georgia con su compañera de baile Mary. Su mundo se ve sacudido con la llegada de Irakli, quien pronto se convierte en su mayor rival y deseo. En este entorno conservador, Merab se ve obligado a liberarse y arriesgarlo todo.

programme.title: Perdido en Florencia
programme.desc: Eric Lombard es un americano con el corazón roto en una fase de su vida en la que tras tomar varias decisiones, decide viajar a Florencia. Allí tratará de descifrar que es lo que más desea, si seguir jugando al fútbol y continuar con su antiguo amor o darle un cambio de rumbo a su vida.

programme.title: Tomboy
programme.desc: Tras instalarse con su familia en un barrio de las afueras de París, Laure, una niña de diez años, aprovecha su aspecto y su co…

programme.title: Lullaby
programme.desc: Un hombre que vive alejado de su familia se entera que su padre, que padece una enfermedad terminal, le nombra encargado de decidir si finalmente se le desconecta del soporte vital o no en las próximas 48 horas. Lo que desencadenará un viaje en el que se encontrará con numerosos aspectos que desconocía, tanto de su vida como de sus seres queridos.

programme.title: Señor Manglehorn
programme.desc: A.J. Manglehorn es un ex convicto que, cuarenta años atrás, renunció a la mujer de sus sueños a cambio de dar un gran golpe. Ahora reside de manera humilde y discreta en una pequeña localidad.

programme.title: The Visitor
programme.desc: Walter Vale, un profesor universitario de Connecticut viaja a Nueva York para dar una conferencia. Allí, en su apartamento de Manhattan que casi nunca visita, encuentra viviendo a una pareja de inmigrantes a quienes alguien les ha alquilado la vivienda haciéndose pasar por el dueño.

programme.title: Va por nosotras
programme.desc: Después de que su equipo de fútbol sea descalificado por insultar al árbitro durante un partido importante, una pequeña ciudad corre el riesgo de perder su financiación y su campo de fútbol. Para evitar este desastre, se decide crear un nuevo equipo formado exclusivamente por mujeres para defender los colores de la ciudad. Pero en una comunidad donde el fútbol siempre ha sido para los hombres, el nuevo estatus de estas mujeres sacudirá la vida cotidiana de sus habitantes.

programme.title: Trinidad y Bambino... (Tal Para Cual)
programme.desc: Trinidad descubre que Bambino fue condenado injustamente y huye con él para buscar a los culpables.

programme.title: Sharknado 4: Que La 4 Te Acompañe
programme.desc: Un extraño Sharknado de arena golpea Las Vegas, Fin vuelve a la acción y lucha contra el Sharknado.

programme.title: El Embajador de la India
programme.desc: Jaime Flórez¸ provinciano astuto y malicioso¸ se ve envuelto en el equívoco en una ciudad colombiana.

programme.title: El Forastero
programme.desc: El forastero procede de un planeta arrasado por el desorden medioambiental y la lluvia radiactiva.

programme.title: Igelak
programme.desc: Pello decide huir y cambiar de identidad, pero acaba viviendo en un edificio okupa.

programme.title: Birdman

programme.title: Blue Mountain State: The Rise of Thadland
programme.desc: Cuando un decano de Blue Mountain State amenaza con cerrar la Hermandad de la Cabra, Alex y el equipo deben atraer a Thad Castle de regreso de la NFL con el mayor festival de alcohol en la historia de BMS.

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Ove no es el típico vecino con el que apetece cruzarte en el barrio. Es un cascarrabias, un pesado que insiste hasta la exageración en mantener el orden y la disciplina, un casi sesentón solitario y resentido a quien el destino ha arrebatado demasiadas cosas.

programme.title: La guerra de los abuelos
programme.desc: Gerri es un abuelo atento y cariñoso, vive con la familia de su hija, ayuda en la casa y cuida de sus nietos. El abuelo Tom irrumpe en este perfecto equilibrio familiar, regresando a Italia después de años de vivir en el extranjero.

programme.title: La hermana del novio
programme.desc: Audrey cumplirá 40 años y su hermano se casará con una chica que conoció en Francia. Antes de la boda se revela un secreto, Audrey y la joven prometida no se llevan bien.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Él es el mejor que existe, de hecho, ¡él es el único! Él es Ace Ventura: Detective de mascotas, dedicado a encontrar a la mascota y mariscal de campo de los Miami Dolphins, Dan Marino. Se enfrentará frente a frente con un tiburón devora-hombres, vigilará a los Miami Dolphins y coqueteará con las chicas. Encubierto, abaleado o bajo el agua, siempre consigue a su hombre… o bestia.

programme.title: El Cielo Se Equivoco
programme.desc: Corinne Jeffries, una mujer dinámica y atractiva, nunca ha superado la muerte de su marido Louie en un desgraciado accidente. A pesar de los años transcurridos, su amor por él sigue intacto. Cuando quedó viuda estaba embarazada y dio luz a Miranda, convertida ya en una hermosa joven. Desde entonces, tuvo el apoyo incondicional de Philip, el mejor amigo de su marido, quien siempre ha estado enamorado de ella. Cuando Louie murió, en el cielo se le brindó la oportunidad de reencarnarse en Alex Finch, un apuesto joven. Al conocer a Miranda por casualidad, Alex/Louie entra de nuevo en la vida de Corinne, desbaratándola por completo.

programme.title: Papa Canguro 2
programme.desc: Charlie Hinton (Cuba Gooding Jr.) y Phil Ryerson (Paul Rae) asumen la dirección de un campamento de verano. Su desconocimiento de los grandes espacios abiertos, unas instalaciones destrozadas y un variopinto grupo de campistas hacen que muy pronto la situación se les vaya de las manos. Frente a las amenazas de cierre y el descenso de inscripciones, Charlie llama a su padre, de quien está distanciado, para que le ayude a organizar el campamento y a enseñar a todo el mundo a trabajar en equipo con perseverancia y flexibilidad.

programme.title: Desmadre De Madres
programme.desc: Lo único que Allyson y sus amigas quieren es una cena pacífica con una charla de adultos...una largamente esperada noche de madres a solas.

programme.title: La marca del zorrillo
programme.desc: En la California de los años 1840, un joven aristócrata descubre un poder extraordinario gracias a una misteriosa poción. Convertido en un inesperado defensor de la justicia, deberá enfrentarse a un gobernador corrupto mientras descubre hasta dónde puede llegar su nuevo poder.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 28, 29, 30
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: Flecha rota
programme.desc: Tom Jeffords intenta hacer la paz entre los colonos y los apaches en el territorio de Arizona.

programme.title: La primera ametralladora del Oeste

programme.title: Las toninas van al Este
programme.desc: Un personaje gay del mundo del espectáculo rechaza la visita de su hija hasta que se entera de que está embarazada.

programme.title: La plegaria del vidente
programme.desc: Una prostituta estrangulada aparece en las afueras de la ciudad de Mar del Plata. Un detective, un periodista y un clarividente colaboran en una compleja investigación que desencadena otros crímenes.

programme.title: Gigantes de Valdés
programme.desc: Un empresario viaja a la Patagonia e intenta convencer a los habitantes de la zona de que construyan un costoso hotel sin tener en cuenta que una construcción de tal magnitud podría destruir la belleza del lugar. Aprenderá una valiosa lección sobre el ecologismo.

programme.title: Angel de la noche
programme.desc: Cuando se trata de conquistar a una mujer, nada resulta más útil que su propio diario. Entre secretos y confesiones, un hombre descubre que el amor puede ser un juego peligroso si conoces demasiado bien los pensamientos de la otra persona.

programme.title: El proyecto Colibrí
programme.desc: Dos primos intentan hacerse millonarios mediante la construcción de un cable de fibra óptica entre Kansas y Nueva Jersey, mientras su antigua jefa intenta evitar que lo consigan

programme.title: Fly
programme.desc: Bex, una joven convicta, se une a un programa de rehabilitación social en la cárcel para lidiar con el doloroso trauma de su crimen. La dura líder del grupo, Ava, intenta encauzar a estos jóvenes por medio de una pasión común: el baile.

programme.title: El pequeño Nicolás
programme.desc: Inclinados sobre un gran folio en blanco en algún lugar entre Montmartre y Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Jean-Jacques Sempé y René Goscinny dan vida a El pequeño Nicolás, un niño risueño y travieso. La suya es una infancia alegre, llena de juegos, diversión, bromas, aprendizaje, complicidad, peleas y castigos. Las aventuras de Nicolás le llevan al estudio de sus creadores, donde habla con ellos de forma distendida. Sempé y Goscinny le cuentan cómo se conocieron y se hicieron amigos, y también responden a preguntas sobre su carrera, su infancia y sus ambiciones.

programme.title: El pequeño Nicolás

programme.title: Carmen
programme.desc: La naturaleza libre y enigmática de una mujer llamada Carmen, su belleza meridional, su carácter arrebatado y pasional, hacen que el sargento José se convierta en víctima y protagonista de acontecimientos extraordinarios.

programme.title: Benidorm mon amour
programme.desc: Tonet aprovecha un permiso de la mili para ir en coche con sus amigos Sento, Jaume y Tomy a Benidorm. Sueñan con disfrutar unos días del sol, las playas y, sobre todo, de las suecas y sus biquinis.

programme.title: El amor no es lo que era
programme.desc: Este film narra tres historias de amor urbanas. Álex y Lucía se encuentran, empiezan a conocerse y entre ellos surge un romance. Paz y Jorge ven impotentes cómo su relación se apaga sin saber qué hacer. Finalmente, Albert e Irene vuelven a verse tras varios decenios de separación.

programme.title: Seis días corrientes
programme.desc: Seis días corrientes relata una semana en la vida de Valero, Moha y Pep, trabajadores de una pequeña empresa de fontanería y electricidad de las afueras de Barcelona.

programme.title: Chocolate Strawberry Vanilla
programme.desc: Awkward, lonely ice-cream truck driver Warren Thompson has two major problems: an unhealthy obsession with a soap opera actress, and a gang of bullies who like to savagely beat him on a regular basis. As Warren slowly slips out of reality and into a psychotic fantasy world to escape his miserable life, a darker, deadlier Warren emerges to deal with his problems and put an end to his tormentors.

programme.title: Estrella Oscura
programme.desc: En los confines del espacio, un pequeno equipo, 20 anos despues de su mision solitaria, descubre que las cosas comienzan a salir hilarantemente mal.

programme.title: Silent Rage
programme.desc: A sheriff tries to stop the killing spree of a mute maniacal murderer who, as the result of years of medical experimentation, has the ability to self-heal.

programme.title: 2 Palomas
programme.desc: Un agente inmobiliario amoral y grasiento es presa de una de sus victimas, que se muda silenciosamente a su apartamento y, sin ser visto, comienza una deliciosa y maliciosa campana de venganza. Two Pigeons es una comedia negra con una vena siniestra.

programme.title: Rosa Leigh
programme.desc: Sixty years ago an unimaginable tragedy struck the Ruth Lee Elementary School when a little girl named Rosa Leigh was killed along with her teacher and the school's janitor. Now, four paranormal investigators seek to debunk the claims which surround the abandoned school. However, they inadvertently release the darkness which dwells within the school.

programme.title: Travesía salvaje
programme.desc: Un cazador de animales exóticos transporta sus últimas adquisiciones en un crucero, entre ellas un jaguar del Amazonas. Desconoce que en el mismo barco se está extraditando a un asesino en serie que, tras escapar del control de sus captores, libera a los animales y con ellos el caos total.

programme.title: Prisionero de guerra
programme.desc: Un soldado capturado durante un conflicto bélico deberá resistir torturas, traiciones y el horror de la guerra para conservar la esperanza de volver a casa.

programme.title: Una amenaza en la sombra
programme.desc: Wes Rawlins es un cazarecompensas y hombre de pocas palabras. Queda devastado cuando su madre es asesinada por una pareja de forajidos.

programme.title: Resistencia
programme.desc: Verano de 1941. Los ejércitos de Hitler avanzan por Europa. Para millones de personas, eso supone una muerte segura, pero para los hermanos Bielski, tres jóvenes granjeros judíos de clase trabajadora, se convierte en algo más.

programme.title: Día de redención
programme.desc: Un héroe de guerra emprende una misión letal para rescatar a la mujer que ama, secuestrada por terroristas.

programme.title: Transmorphers
programme.desc: Una raza de robots alienígenas ha conquistado la Tierra.

programme.title: Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Dos equipos de buscadores de tesoros realizan una excavación ilegal en la isla de Corregidor, Filipinas.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos hallan oro en el desierto australiano la codicia los lleva a arriesgarlo todo.

programme.title: Gloria (1999)
programme.desc: Gloria ha pasado tres años en la cárcel por culpa de su novio mafioso, Kevin. Nada más salir, se salta la libertad condicional y vuelve a Nueva York con su banda. Al llegar, se encuentra con que Kevin y los suyos han secuestrado a un niño después de matar a sus padres.

programme.title: Resident Evil
programme.desc: El mortífero virus T de la Corporación Umbrella se extiende por el planeta y transforma a gente común y corriente en legiones de muertos vivientes. La raza humana va camino a la extinción y tiene solo una esperanza: Alice (Milla Jovovich). Ella tiene la misión de abrirse paso por ciudades y a través de continentes, todo dentro de la instalación de investigación principal de Umbrella. Viejos amigos se convierten en nuevos enemigos mientras Alice lucha por escapar y descubre que todo lo que cree quizá no sea verdad.

programme.title: Resident Evil
programme.desc: Alice (Milla Jovovich) está de vuelta en la cuarta entrega de la saga Resident Evil. Ahora, sin poderes superhumanos, se unirá a sus compañeros supervivientes Claire y Chris (Ali Larter y Wentworth Miller) para enfrentarse a los ejércitos de los no-muertos y acabar con la Corporación Umbrella cuyo virus los ha creado.

programme.title: Cazafantasmas (2016)
programme.desc: Nueva versión de una de las películas más emblemáticas de los años ochenta: Los cazafantasmas. Después de casi treinta años, los fantasmas y demonios se han vuelto a escapar de los infiernos para destruir Manhattan. Ahora, el equipo de los Cazafantasmas está formado por un grupo de mujeres dispuestas a terminar con todas las amenazas paranormales.
